mapper.select: WITH callback_input AS ( SELECT raw.ordinal, DECODE(raw."idHex", 'hex') AS callback_id, DECODE(raw."orderIdHex", 'hex') AS order_id, raw."providerTradeNo" AS provider_trade_no, raw."tradeStatus" AS trade_status, raw."paidAmountYuan" AS paid_amount_yuan, raw."paidAt" AS paid_at, raw."receivedAt" AS received_at FROM jsonb_to_recordset( CAST(#{callbacksJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB) ) AS raw( ordinal INTEGER, "idHex" TEXT, "orderIdHex" TEXT, "providerTradeNo" TEXT, "tradeStatus" TEXT, "paidAmountYuan" NUMERIC, "paidAt" TIMESTAMPTZ, "receivedAt" TIMESTAMPTZ ) ), inserted AS ( INSERT INTO membership_payment_callback ( id, order_id, provider_trade_no, trade_status, paid_amount_yuan, paid_at, received_at ) SELECT callback_id, order_id, provider_trade_no, trade_status, paid_amount_yuan, paid_at, received_at FROM callback_input ORDER BY ordinal ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING RETURNING id, order_id, provider_trade_no, trade_status, paid_at, resolution, resolved_at ), callback_facts AS ( SELECT id, order_id, provider_trade_no, trade_status, resolution FROM inserted UNION ALL SELECT id, order_id, provider_trade_no, trade_status, resolution FROM membership_payment_callback ), resolved AS ( SELECT callback_input.ordinal, callback_input.callback_id, callback_input.order_id AS requested_order_id, COALESCE( order_fact.id, provider_fact.id, id_fact.id ) AS persisted_callback_id, COALESCE( order_fact.order_id, provider_fact.order_id, id_fact.order_id ) AS persisted_order_id, callback_input.provider_trade_no, callback_input.trade_status, COALESCE( order_fact.resolution, provider_fact.resolution, id_fact.resolution ) AS resolution, inserted_for_input.id AS inserted_id, order_fact.id AS order_fact_id, order_fact.provider_trade_no AS order_fact_provider_trade_no, provider_fact.id AS provider_fact_id, provider_fact.order_id AS provider_fact_order_id, id_fact.id AS id_fact_id FROM callback_input LEFT JOIN callback_facts order_fact ON order_fact.order_id = callback_input.order_id LEFT JOIN callback_facts provider_fact ON provider_fact.provider_trade_no = callback_input.provider_trade_no LEFT JOIN callback_facts id_fact ON id_fact.id = callback_input.callback_id LEFT JOIN inserted inserted_for_input ON inserted_for_input.id = callback_input.callback_id ) SELECT ordinal, callback_id, requested_order_id, persisted_order_id, persisted_callback_id, provider_trade_no, trade_status, resolution, CASE WHEN inserted_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'INSERTED' WHEN order_fact_id IS NOT NULL AND provider_fact_id IS NOT NULL AND order_fact_id <> provider_fact_id THEN 'IDENTITY_CONFLICT' WHEN order_fact_id IS NOT NULL AND order_fact_provider_trade_no <> provider_trade_no THEN 'ORDER_DUPLICATE' WHEN provider_fact_id IS NOT NULL AND provider_fact_order_id <> requested_order_id THEN 'PROVIDER_TRADE_REUSED' WHEN id_fact_id IS NOT NULL AND persisted_order_id <> requested_order_id THEN 'CALLBACK_ID_REUSED' ELSE 'DUPLICATE' END AS outcome, inserted_id IS NOT NULL AS inserted, inserted_id IS NULL AND order_fact_id IS NOT NULL AND NOT ( provider_fact_id IS NOT NULL AND order_fact_id <> provider_fact_id ) AS duplicate, persisted_callback_id = callback_id AS same_callback, ( provider_fact_id IS NOT NULL AND provider_fact_order_id <> requested_order_id ) OR ( id_fact_id IS NOT NULL AND persisted_order_id <> requested_order_id ) AS order_mismatch FROM resolved ORDER BY ordinal
mapper.update: WITH raw_resolutions AS ( SELECT DECODE(raw."callbackIdHex", 'hex') AS callback_id, raw.resolution, raw."resolvedAt" AS resolved_at FROM jsonb_to_recordset( CAST(#{resolutionsJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS JSONB) ) AS raw( "callbackIdHex" TEXT, resolution TEXT, "resolvedAt" TIMESTAMPTZ ) ), resolutions AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (callback_id) callback_id, resolution, resolved_at FROM raw_resolutions ORDER BY callback_id ) UPDATE membership_payment_callback SET resolution = COALESCE( membership_payment_callback.resolution, resolutions.resolution), resolved_at = COALESCE( membership_payment_callback.resolved_at, resolutions.resolved_at) FROM resolutions WHERE membership_payment_callback.id = resolutions.callback_id AND ( membership_payment_callback.resolution IS NULL OR membership_payment_callback.resolution = resolutions.resolution )
